The '''Morellian Commonwealth''' was a [[Wild Space/Legends|Wild Space]]<ref name="EAOC" /> [[Star cluster/Legends|star cluster]].<ref name="TEA">''[[The Essential Atlas]]''</ref> It contained several [[Star system/Legends|star systems]],<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> including the [[Morellia system/Legends|Morellia system]],<ref name="EAOC" /> the site of the astronomical object of the [[Morellia/Legends|same name]].<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" />

The Morellian Commonwealth was home to a long-lived [[near-Human]] [[Species/Legends|species]] known as the [[Morellian]]s. The Morellian systems utilized technology of a relatively low level, and tasked the [[Morellian Enforcers]] with maintaining law and order within the Commonwealth. The Morellian [[Barosa Warren]] was [[Reproduction/Legends|born]] on Morellia approximately 160 [[Standard year/Legends|years]] before<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]],<ref name="Date">''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'' represents a collection of [[in-universe]] reports from "one [[Standard year/Legends|year]] before the [[Battle of Hoth/Legends|Battle of Hoth]]," which corresponds to [[2 ABY/Legends|2 ABY]], according to ''[[The New Essential Chronology]]''.</ref> and, by that year, was believed to be the last Morellian in existence.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Morellian Commonwealth was introduced in ''[[Alliance Intelligence Reports]]'', a [[1995]] sourcebook for [[West End Games]]' ''[[Star Wars: The Roleplaying Game]]''.<ref name="Alliance Intelligence Reports" /> The [[2009]] reference book ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'' placed the cluster's Morellia system in grid square S-3.<ref name="TEA Morellia" />
